description: Which JSON files tools/json-check.mjs validates against which schema. Paths are relative to src/. A schema path may end with a JSON pointer, for example config/schema/x.schema.json#/$defs/y. An entry whose schema file does not exist yet is reported as pending, unless files already match it.
